reported_failed_attempts: Independent random bipartition estimation has exponential relative second moment even on a unique-perfect-matching instance.
The exact alternating conditional chain has exponential mixing on even cycles.
Simple alternating walks and bipartition proposals have exponentially small phase-crossing probability on the reported gadget family.
Uniformly sampling all alternating simple cycles is an uncharged hard primitive under the stated reduction; exact small-gadget elimination does not extend here to many-boundary interactions.
